panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Non-idle CPU usage over the rate interval; idle CPU is current headroom, not a reservation.

panels.title: RAM
panels.description: Available RAM includes reclaimable memory. Namespace working sets do not include all host overhead.

panels.title: Physical disks
panels.description: Deduplicated physical filesystems. Available space excludes filesystem-reserved blocks; namespace disks share this capacity.

panels.title: Scheduling — requests, separate from actual usage
CPU scheduling capacity
panels.description: Active pod requests, including init-container maximum and pod overhead. Negative headroom indicates over-reservation. Assumes no restartable init sidecars (none are currently deployed).

targets.expr: ((sum((max by(namespace,pod)(label_replace(sum by(namespace,pod)(max by(namespace,pod,container)(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})),"request_kind","regular","pod",".*") or label_replace(max by(namespace,pod)(kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"}),"request_kind","init","pod",".*"))) * on(namespace,pod) (max by(namespace,pod)(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1))) or vector(0)) + (sum(kube_pod_overhead_cpu_cores * on(namespace,pod) (max by(namespace,pod)(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1))) or vector(0)))

(sum(max by(node)(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"}))) - (((sum((max by(namespace,pod)(label_replace(sum by(namespace,pod)(max by(namespace,pod,container)(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})),"request_kind","regular","pod",".*") or label_replace(max by(namespace,pod)(kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"}),"request_kind","init","pod",".*"))) * on(namespace,pod) (max by(namespace,pod)(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1))) or vector(0)) + (sum(kube_pod_overhead_cpu_cores * on(namespace,pod) (max by(namespace,pod)(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1))) or vector(0))))

panels.title: CPU by namespace
panels.description: Measured usage. Disk combines persistent and ephemeral bytes only when both measurements are available; it is not a namespace quota.

panels.title: RAM by namespace
panels.description: Measured usage. Disk combines persistent and ephemeral bytes only when both measurements are available; it is not a namespace quota.

panels.title: Disk by namespace
panels.description: Measured usage. Disk combines persistent and ephemeral bytes only when both measurements are available; it is not a namespace quota.

panels.title: Namespace summary
panels.description: Sort any column to find the largest consumers. Blank storage values mean collection is incomplete or stale. Persistent includes PVCs and configured application host paths. Ephemeral includes pod writable layers, logs and disk-backed temporary volumes. Network receive/transmit are bits per second and exclude host-network pods; missing attribution is blank rather than zero.

panels.title: Cluster network traffic
panels.description: Physical Ethernet interfaces (en*/eth*), including host and tunnel/overlay traffic. Virtual interfaces are excluded to avoid duplicate traffic. This is not an Internet speed test.

panels.title: Ethernet link capacity
panels.description: Sum of reported physical Ethernet link speeds, currently 1 Gbit/s. Full-duplex capacity applies independently to receive and transmit; Internet throughput may be lower. Unknown/nonpositive speeds are excluded.

panels.title: Ethernet link utilization
panels.description: Each direction is compared independently with negotiated Ethernet link speed; not Internet bandwidth usage.

panels.title: Receive by namespace
panels.description: Non-host-network pods only; deduplicated per pod/interface. Includes traffic between pods and services, so namespace traffic does not sum to physical NIC traffic. Host-network traffic cannot be attributed reliably and remains in node totals.

panels.title: Transmit by namespace
panels.description: Non-host-network pods only; deduplicated per pod/interface. Includes traffic between pods and services, so namespace traffic does not sum to physical NIC traffic. Host-network traffic cannot be attributed reliably and remains in node totals.

panels.title: Namespace receive history
panels.description: Non-host-network pods only; deduplicated per pod/interface. Includes traffic between pods and services, so namespace traffic does not sum to physical NIC traffic. Host-network traffic cannot be attributed reliably and remains in node totals.

panels.title: Namespace transmit history
panels.description: Non-host-network pods only; deduplicated per pod/interface. Includes traffic between pods and services, so namespace traffic does not sum to physical NIC traffic. Host-network traffic cannot be attributed reliably and remains in node totals.

panels.title: Cluster network history
panels.description: Physical Ethernet interfaces (en*/eth*), including host and tunnel/overlay traffic. Virtual interfaces are excluded to avoid duplicate traffic. This is not an Internet speed test.

panels.title: Disk collection successful
panels.description: 1 = complete and fresh; 0 = failed or stale. Disk scans run every five minutes; values expire after ten minutes.
